steps.text: The side contact works. A sweep found a reliable press at TCP x≈`-0.12`: the handle descends to z≈`0.067`, crossing native success after the full press. I’m replaying that exact path in a fresh episode and saving its controls.

from mw_runtime import Session
s=Session()
for p,n in [((-.18,.73,.25),40),((-.18,.73,.16),25),((-.12,.73,.025),55)]:
 s.move(p,gripper=-1,steps=n)
r=s.result(); o=s.observe()
print('success',r['success'],'final_success',r['final_success'],'n_actions',r['n_actions'])
print('tcp',o['tcp'],'handle',o['bodies']['handle_link']['position'],'info',r['info'])
assert r['success']==1
s.save('/app/output/trajectory.npz')
print('saved')
